results.title: Diaby departure rejected: Al-Ittihad fans rise up to protect their star man
results.description: The French star makes headlines! Al-Ittihad supporters have launched a fierce campaign on "X" under the hashtag (#Diaby_Departure_Rejected1), a clear message of their outright rejection of any move that takes France's Moussa Diaby away from "the Dean".

results.title: Jonathan Kuminga odds point heavily to 2 teams after Peyton Watson trade
